SYSTEMD_MCP_FALLBACK_KEY.description: API key for optional Haiku fallback AI integration (Anthropic API key)

SYSTEMD_MCP_ALLOW_RESTART.description: Enable restart permission via environment variable (set to 1 to enable)

SYSTEMD_MCP_ALLOW_START_STOP.description: Enable start/stop permission via environment variable (set to 1 to enable)

servers.name: systemd-mcp
